relations: Continuous atmospheric flow across the fixed ridge causes mist to translate along the crest, alternately revealing and veiling the ridgeline.
Shifting cloud density over the slopes thickens fog to obscure the left summit while thinning to outline the right slope.
Persistent wind drift keeps low-lying mist moving continuously across the terrain while foreground vegetation remains fixed.
caption: A dark mountain ridge stands silhouetted beneath a bright, overexposed sun near the top center, while low-lying mist and clouds already drift continuously across and over its slopes. Wisps that hug the incline thicken and shift, their density rising and falling as they translate along the crest, alternately revealing and veiling the ridgeline. The motion is dominated by the fog, since the terrain remains essentially fixed while the glowing orb shows only slight apparent drift. Radiant sunbeams slant downward through the haze, their angle and intensity shifting as intervening cloud density varies, though no new light source appears or disappears. The left summit grows progressively more obscured as fog thickens midway through, while the right-hand slope, partly veiled at first, becomes more distinctly outlined later. Foreground vegetation along the bottom stays fixed. The fog keeps moving continuously across the slopes.
